responsive.evidence: Calendar fixtures assert document width and dialog/save-button bounds in both themes at 1440x1000 and 390x844; native control preview verifies adjacent boolean choices.

loading.evidence: apply-browser.json visible request state and elapsed feedback; pending calendar Save blocks repeats and close.

empty.evidence: Empty fixture dates render an honest no-event agenda; no generated sample records reach the server.

error.evidence: calendar-browser.json covers HTTP500 and malformed login HTML with explicit retry; apply-browser.json preserves pending changes on failure.

partial.evidence: apply-browser.json asserts warning outcome separately from clean success.

success.evidence: apply-browser.json clears pending only after boolean success; calendar-browser.json accepts the mutation status contract.

permission.evidence: Both fixture suites keep expired-login responses distinct from success.
